text:
Ella PR: Heads-up — need to swap the 9am ET analyst brief to 11am ET. Found conflict with EU call. Can we move?
Matt PM: Who's on the 11am slot currently?
Sophia Marketing: It's reserved for a demo with Acme press. They said flexible til EOD. We can ask to shift.
Raj AR: 11am would be fine for the analyst, they prefer earlier but OK. Who will handle the updated quote approvals?
Ella PR: I'll take quotes. Need final quote by 4pm PT. Pinged legal.
PressOps: calendar-bot: Draft invite waiting for confirm — link incoming.
CalendarBot: @here Event draft created: https://cal.example.com/event/12345 (tentative move to 11:00 ET)
Matt PM: Ok confirm with Acme PR rep? I can offer 10:30 as compromise.
Sophia Marketing: 10:30 ET works better for APAC overlap. @Ella PR want me to send the new invite?
Ella PR: Yes, please. Also need factpack attached. Use this doc: https://drive.example.com/factpack_v2 — latest numbers in section "Benchmarks"
Raj AR: I'll validate the benchmark language. Small ask: can we avoid calling it "industry-leading" — prefer "market-competitive" in analyst-facing materials.
Ella PR: noted. I'll update quote language to "market-competitive performance on latency and cost."
Matt PM: Also add the p50/p95 numbers? Which do we include?
Raj AR: Keep p50/p95 and cost-per-token estimate. I'll paste the quick block:
```text
p50 latency: 80ms
p95 latency: 210ms
cost: $0.0025/token (estimate)
```
Sophia Marketing: Nice. Will add to the factpack under "Benchmarks (engineer-verified)".
PressOps: Acme PR confirmed willing to move to 10:30. They asked we don't share embargo before 10am ET.
Ella PR: Good — set embargo window: publish after 10:00 ET. Also need analyst quote sign-off. Matt, can you approve final technical line?
Matt PM: I can sign off by 3pm PT.
Raj AR: FYI analysts asked for a ~15min exclusive window for questions. Blocked in calendar.
Ella PR: Great. I will send the updated invites and attach factpack. Sending draft quote now:
Ella PR: "Redwood Inference is excited to deliver market-competitive latency and cost for real-world LLM workloads, enabling product teams to ship reliably at scale."
Sophia Marketing: Tweaking suggestion: "enabling engineering teams to ship LLM features with predictable latency, cost, and reliability." Slightly more product-y.
Ella PR: love it. Finalizing.
CalendarBot: Event updated: https://cal.example.com/event/12345?updated
Ella PR: Thanks everyone. Will post final in #press-ops when quote + factpack locked. :thumbsup: 
PressOps: ack.
